title: Computer Architecture: A Quantitative Approach
description: Browse 62 original hardware examples accompanying editions 1–7 of Hennessy and Patterson’s textbook. Each example includes a guide, two HDL implementations, and self-checking testbenches; check each guide for verification status.

start.title: Start here
start.description: Install Python 3, Icarus Verilog 12 and GHDL 4.x, then run these commands from this textbook repository. The browser links below open guides and source files; simulations run locally.
commands: make test                    # run both HDL test suites
make test T=set_assoc_cache   # run one example

scope: Examples are organized by topic: main chapter numbers follow the sixth and seventh editions, and appendix letters follow the fifth. Use the edition guide and each example’s references to locate the material in your own edition. Coverage is selective; this index does not certify simulation results.
